interpretation: 将“波次1可以删除”解释为取消唯一WooCommerce explore委派，由主agent完成同样的全目录分页、price与多类别取数工作，之后保留三个writer岗位。不是删除必要的数据源。仅有Start/Next/Finally叙述枚举不建立额外屏障：主agent可原生并行推进本店与竞品取源，原有三个产物writer继续并行消费统一冻结数据。

changes.original: use one small source wave for the paginated WooCommerce catalog only, then one parallel artifact wave of three writers; the competitor web read, the analysis and the frozen data files stay with the main agent.
changes.replacement: have the main agent retrieve the paginated WooCommerce catalog directly, then use one artifact stage of three writers; the competitor web read, the analysis and the frozen data files also stay with the main agent. Do not dispatch a source-collection explore sub-agent.
changes.explanation: 取消源采集子agent，把完整WooCommerce工作交主agent，保留分析与最终writer职责。
